items.text: It will NOT remove a wrinkle. Nothing on the surface does
It will not undo sun damage or lift age spots
The de-puffing is TEMPORARY — hours, not days
It is not sunscreen. The sun is still the one thing that matters

beats.title: Three different dark circles — only one answers to coffee
items: BLUE or PURPLE, worse when tired — vascular. This is the one caffeine helps.
BROWN and flat — pigment, from genes or sun. Coffee does very little.
A HOLLOW under the bone — that is a shadow. No cream casts light into it.

beats.eyebrow: Brown is pigment, not blood
beats.caption: Genetic or sun. Coffee grounds will do very little for it — and you deserve to know before you spend a month hoping.

beats.eyebrow: The 10-second test you can do tonight
beats.title: Hold a lamp below your face
beats.body: If the darkness fills in and vanishes, it was never a stain. It was a shadow — and no kitchen remedy casts light into a hollow.

Scrubbing it in circles

beats.myth: Massage it in circles for two minutes, really work it in

beats.eyebrow: Under any magnification
beats.title: A coffee ground is a shard
beats.body: Irregular, hard-edged, broken — like tiny gravel. Dragged across your face for two minutes it does not exfoliate, it tears.

items.sub: the thing you were about to throw away is the thing that works

beats.title: The whole thing, in three lines
items: 1 · USED grounds, brewed and cooled — never fresh dry ones out of the bag.
2 · A spoon of plain full-fat yogurt. Press it on with an open palm.
3 · Leave it 4–5 minutes. Rinse with your bare hand. Two or three mornings a week.
